required_manual_checks.description: On 2026-09-30 the full db phase failed three consecutive times on 2A.3a-2's checkpoint tree (8b4d376, tree dc6b1b0), whose code is byte-identical to f2854ca, which had passed the full db phase hours earlier. Failures: 10-11 tests. (1) production-authorization 'MUTATION: the rollbacks above left production intact' lists events triggers by relname across ALL schemas and saw 4 instead of 2, because request-isolation and pooled-principal create ascend_request_test / ascend_pool_test (each with an events table) in production while other files run in parallel. An owner-run read-only catalog check afterwards found no non-system schema besides public, so there is no residue: it is a scheduling race. (2) Local PGlite suites (consumer-parity, graph-projection-scoping, intake-identity, intake-route, intake-second-import, mutation, prospect-notes, research-website, scale, substrate-migration, substrate) failed with unserializable errors (STACK_TRACE_ERROR) only inside the full parallel db run; the five run alone with no database environment pass 80/0.

Scope every production shape assertion that names a table to schema public (namespace-qualified catalog queries), so a concurrent scratch schema cannot change the answer; do not weaken what is asserted. Separately, ensure the production-scratch suites (request-isolation, pooled-principal) never overlap suites that inspect production's catalog, by the least invasive mechanism (for example a dedicated sequential project or file-level serialization in the db phase), and prove it.

Establish the actual cause of the PGlite failures under the full run (resource exhaustion, worker count, shared global state, timeouts) with value-free evidence, and fix the cause. Raising timeouts or retrying without a demonstrated cause is not acceptable. No test is skipped or reclassified.

If gate-proof.mjs or the suites' own teardown is changed, a failed db phase must still leave no production scratch schema; state how this is guaranteed, since the orchestrator's residue check runs only after a green db phase.

Before: reproduction of the failure pattern on an unchanged tree. After: at least three consecutive full db-phase runs green on the candidate tree, each followed by a clear residue check; mutants showing the scoped catalog query still fails on a real change to public's triggers. The db phase reads production and creates and drops its own scratch schemas as today; no other production write.
Diff limited to the write paths; gate classification and application code unchanged. After promotion, 2A.3a-2 re-proves its checkpoint tree and freezes.

title: GATE-2G1-006 Make the db proof phase deterministic: scope production shape checks, serialize production-scratch suites, fix PGlite failures under the full run
